ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T32B.1 Adaptive Forbidden Fingerprint
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T32-B.1 for RimWorld 1.5. T32-A Reservation Transaction remains active. T21 Forbidden fingerprint capture is now adaptive per validator method+scanner trust state: cold/low-reuse validators keep T32-B Lazy stores, while already-trusted validators with sustained first-repeat rate >=12.5% switch to Eager capture so first repeats retain the original T21 replay opportunity. Eager returns to Lazy below 6.25% after sufficient evidence. Hysteresis and bounded evidence prevent flapping. False-only authority, live parity, mismatch quarantine, package-local lifetime, T32-A and zero-wait remain unchanged. No WorkGiver/mod-name specialization is used.
